title: Visual authority and implementation scope
rule: Latest owner directions and this v3 module pack control. Presentation slides 1–16 are authoritative. Later slides are historical inspiration; the older Study concept remains an approved rough layout/behaviour reference with the current wrapper. Mock-ups define design intent, not product-verification status.

title: Global Assistants and Specialists
rule: Assistants and Specialists are global systems accessible from Home and editors. Editor collaborator avatars/pickers expose them in the current artifact context. Spaces retains their conversation views. Persistent identity, Main threads, memory, tools, permissions and durable Task/Runs are shared canonical entities.

title: Notifications owns ecosystem activity
rule: Remove Events as a user-facing navigation destination. Notifications owns notification history and typed ecosystem activity. Existing EventID, provenance, audit and deep-link contracts remain valid backend contracts and are not deleted.

title: New Tab icon rail
rule: New Tab uses the compact icon rail shown in the current mock-up. Apps, Dashboard, Models and New Tab remain discoverable semantic destinations. This changes navigation presentation, not the canonical Home services or tab identities.

title: Eight current themes and specified material treatments
rule: The current themes are Professional, Glow, Playful, Frosted Glass, Bubble, Metallic, Retro and Western, plus Create Theme. Cinematic is legacy compatibility. Bubble uses watery dimensional surfaces and wobble with reduced-motion alternatives; Western uses wood/sepia treatment; Retro uses a monospace treatment. The Professional annex remains normative. Layout topology and authored content do not change with theme.

title: Spaces conversation permissions
rule: Spaces uses an icon labelled Conversation permissions. It controls current-conversation context/action scope and cannot widen durable grants. It is distinct from editor AI Read-only/Write and from document Edit/Suggest/View.

title: Model discovery alongside local management
rule: Models is a discovery and comparison experience with local installed-model management available as a distinct useful view. Provider identity, capabilities, hardware fit and unknown metadata remain truthful.

title: Spaces generative output and execution visibility
rule: Provide typed interactive Generative UI, visible subagent progress/detail, high-level thinking/work summaries, live semantic work in Present and Canvas, and durable generated-file output cards. Open resolves the canonical artifact; Download appears only when verified durable bytes exist. Failed export preserves saved native artifacts. Never expose private internal chain-of-thought.

title: Copyable app modules
rule: Each app module is organised as Prerequisites, Overview, Layouts & visible states, Features & behaviour, Canonical entities & persistence, Permissions & recovery, Acceptance checks and Source clause IDs. Modules include the exact current mock-up mapping and named retained technical subchunks.

title: Consistent Home identity
rule: Use the house Home icon consistently in app/host navigation; preserve semantic Home targets and current app-specific identity.

title: Boards meaningful editing states
rule: Represent page Add/type, page options, insertion-between-blocks, typing/caret, selected blocks, dragging and ink/tool options. Preserve local native editing without a required Files account and independent Edit/View, Locked and Snap semantics.

title: Write document layouts
rule: Show Continuous and actual paginated Pages/Book layouts of the same canonical document with correct selection and contextual controls; changing view never creates a duplicate document.

title: Present Actions and custom shapes
rule: Provide explicit meaningful Actions and custom-shape creation/editing states within the approved three-tier Present shell, preserving canonical object/action semantics, notes and manipulation.

title: Files selection and content padding
rule: Provide comfortable content and selected-row padding so icons, names and metadata do not collide with selection backgrounds or table edges; preserve real file-management density and operations.

title: Planner event nib
rule: Planner event cards use a clear colour nib and readable interior padding, while event identity, time/recurrence and state remain authoritative.

title: Cards neighbouring offsets
rule: Focused Cards show visibly offset neighbouring cards with clear front/back and Edit versus View semantics; vertical stack is the default and supported horizontal orientation remains available.

title: Native emoji
rule: Emoji characters use native platform emoji rendering. Do not substitute text-glyph boxes or custom application icons for emoji; keep coherent app/control icon assets separate.

title: Confirmed discrete effort mapping supersedes ambiguous percentage mapping
rule: SPUI-133 explicitly supersedes application of the older arbitrary-percentage floor formula to the visible effort presets. Visible choices map bijectively to actual provider LevelIDs/ordinals. Any retained arbitrary-percent legacy API must be separately versioned and cannot shift or duplicate the displayed tier choices.

title: Expired delivery schedules and worker assignments
rule: Historical dated schedules and named worker/session assignments are provenance, not current product requirements or execution authorisation. Compatible product/runtime, packaging, platform, security and acceptance requirements remain active; original process wording is retained in the history ledger.
